note: Both sets extract the same three clothes-dryer scoring thresholds from Figure 8 with accurate quotes and correct inequality bounds (≤100 full, 100–110 reduced, ≥110 none). Set A adds a generic 'scoring for laundry loads' condition and labels the entity 'clothes drying', while Set B uses 'clothes drying task' with 'full/reduced/no points condition' attributes; neither misbinds or invents anything. The only minor quibble is that both render the reduced-points variable as 'x' rather than '% of original weight', which is equally trivial in both. Coverage and fidelity are effectively identical.
